response.overview: # The Reunion of Dr. Maira and Dr. Zane  The reunion of Dr. Maira and Dr. Zane reignites a love story that never truly ended, while family secrets, medical ethical dilemmas, professional rivalry and past trauma test every decision made. Dr. Maira begins her practice as an expert oncology trainer, but is shocked by the sudden return of Dr. Zane, the man who once broke her heart. As they face various cancer patient cases, their professional relationship becomes increasingly complicated when it is revealed that Wanie, a teenage patient, is Zane's half-sister who was left with their biological mother long ago. Past trauma, guilt and family conflict begin to disturb Zane's focus, while Maira increasingly understands the wounds he has hidden. The appearance of Aris, a child confirmed to have leukemia, tests the competence and humanitarian values of the entire medical team. A debate erupts between conventional treatment approaches and experimental clinical trials brought by Prof.
response.title: Diagnosis Cinta
